name: Publish check action
on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      version:
        description: 'Immutable action version, e.g. 1.0.0 (publishes check-v1.0.0 and check-v1)'
        required: true
        type: string
concurrency:
  group: publish-check-action
  cancel-in-progress: false
permissions:
  contents: read
jobs:
  verify:
    strategy:
      matrix:
        os: [ubuntu-latest, windows-latest, macos-latest]
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '24'
          cache: pnpm
      - run: node scripts/prepare-core-install.mjs
      - run: pnpm --dir packages/core install --ignore-workspace --frozen-lockfile --ignore-scripts
      - run: pnpm build:action-test
      - run: pnpm test:action
      - uses: ./
  publish:
    needs: verify
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: write
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Publish minimal action snapshot and tags
        env:
          ACTION_VERSION: ${{ inputs.version }}
        run: |
          [[ "$ACTION_VERSION" =~ ^[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+$ ]] || { echo 'Expected version X.Y.Z'; exit 1; }
          immutable="check-v$ACTION_VERSION"
          major="check-v${ACTION_VERSION%%.*}"
          if git ls-remote --exit-code --tags origin "refs/tags/$immutable"; then
            echo "Tag $immutable already exists"; exit 1
          fi
          source_commit="$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
          artifact="$(mktemp -d)"
          cp -R action.yml action LICENSE "$artifact/"
          echo '{"private":true,"type":"module"}' > "$artifact/package.json"
          git checkout --orphan action-release
          git rm -rf .
          cp -a "$artifact/." .
          git add --force action.yml action package.json LICENSE
          git config user.name 'github-actions[bot]'
          git config user.email '41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com'
          git commit -m "Check action $ACTION_VERSION from $source_commit"
          git tag "$immutable"
          git tag -f "$major"
          git push --atomic origin "refs/tags/$immutable" "+refs/tags/$major"

name: CI

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]

jobs:
  test:
    # Run the full suite on Linux and Windows so platform-specific issues
    # (path separators, line endings) are caught before release.
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        os: [ubuntu-latest, windows-latest]
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '22'
          cache: pnpm

      # Rust toolchain for the @lat.md/embed candle → WASM engine.
      - uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable
        with:
          targets: wasm32-unknown-unknown
      - uses: Swatinem/rust-cache@v2
        with:
          workspaces: packages/embed/crate

      # Cache the ~90 MB MiniLM weights fetched + converted by build-weights.mjs
      # (the script is idempotent and skips the fetch when model/ is present), so
      # CI doesn't re-download from HuggingFace every run. Keyed on the fetch
      # script so a change to the weights source busts the cache.
      - name: Cache MiniLM weights
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: packages/embed-minilm-fp16/model
          key: minilm-weights-${{ matrix.os }}-${{ hashFiles('packages/embed-minilm-fp16/scripts/build-weights.mjs') }}

      - run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

      # buildall = packages (WASM engine + fp16 weights + tsc) then top-level lat.
      - run: pnpm buildall
      - run: pnpm vitest run --reporter=verbose
      - run: pnpm test:core
        env:
          LAT_TEST_FULL_PACKAGE: '1'
